tracks.title: Proof foundations
tracks.description: Construction, criticism, and formal dependency structure of proofs.

tracks.title: Advanced linear algebra
tracks.description: Vector spaces, operators, canonical forms, tensors, and spectral methods.

tracks.title: Real analysis
tracks.description: Completeness, convergence, compactness, differentiation, and integration.

tracks.title: Complex analysis
tracks.description: Holomorphic functions, contour methods, residues, and conformal theory.

tracks.title: Functional analysis
tracks.description: Infinite-dimensional spaces, operators, duality, and weak topologies.

tracks.title: Harmonic analysis
tracks.description: Fourier, convolution, distributional, and localization methods.

tracks.title: Abstract algebra
tracks.description: Groups, rings, fields, modules, representations, and categorical structure.

tracks.title: Commutative algebra
tracks.description: Noetherian, local, ideal-theoretic, and computational methods.

tracks.title: Topology
tracks.description: General topology, compactness, separation, convergence, and manifolds.

tracks.title: Algebraic topology
tracks.description: Homotopy, homology, cohomology, and spectral-sequence invariants.

tracks.title: Differential geometry
tracks.description: Smooth manifolds, bundles, connections, curvature, and Lie theory.

tracks.title: Differential equations and dynamical systems
tracks.description: ODE, PDE, stability, bifurcation, and weak-solution theory.

tracks.title: Measure, probability, and stochastic processes
tracks.description: Measure-theoretic probability, limit theory, martingales, and stochastic calculus.

tracks.title: Statistics
tracks.description: Estimation, testing, regression, asymptotics, Bayesian, and causal methods.

tracks.title: Combinatorics and graph theory
tracks.description: Enumeration, extremal and probabilistic methods, graphs, and matroids.

tracks.title: Number theory
tracks.description: Diophantine, analytic, algebraic, local, and arithmetic-geometric methods.

tracks.title: Logic and set theory
tracks.description: Formal semantics, computability, axiomatic set theory, forcing, and model theory.

tracks.title: Numerical analysis and optimization
tracks.description: Stable algorithms, approximation, discretization, convexity, and duality.

tracks.title: Mathematical research practice
tracks.description: Corpus discipline, reproducibility, formalization, review, and bounded research.

tracks.title: Information Theory
tracks.description: Entropy, coding, channels, and operational information limits.

tracks.title: Control and Sequential Decision Systems
tracks.description: State-space control, estimation, and sequential decisions under uncertainty.

tracks.title: Mathematical Learning and Inference
tracks.description: Generalization, kernels, probabilistic inference, and transport methods.

tracks.title: Advanced Convex Optimization
tracks.description: Conic, robust, proximal, and distributed optimization methods.

tracks.title: Algebraic Geometry
tracks.description: Varieties, schemes, sheaves, divisors, and cohomological geometry.

tracks.title: Operator and Noncommutative Algebra
tracks.description: Operator spectra, operator algebras, and noncommutative module structure.

formalProofObligations.title: Induction from well ordering
formalProofObligations.statement: Formalize that well ordering of natural numbers implies strong induction for an arbitrary decidable predicate.

formalProofObligations.title: Finite rank-nullity
formalProofObligations.statement: Formalize rank-nullity for a linear map between finite-dimensional vector spaces.

formalProofObligations.title: Monotone convergence
formalProofObligations.statement: Formalize monotone convergence for a nonnegative increasing sequence of measurable functions.

formalProofObligations.title: First isomorphism theorem
formalProofObligations.statement: Formalize the first isomorphism theorem for groups including the induced quotient map.

formalProofObligations.title: Continuous image of compact space
formalProofObligations.statement: Formalize that the continuous image of a compact topological space is compact.

formalProofObligations.title: Conditional-expectation tower property
formalProofObligations.statement: Formalize the tower property for integrable random variables over nested sigma algebras.

formalProofObligations.title: Research artifact main result
formalProofObligations.statement: Kernel-check the bounded research artifact main theorem with its artifact digest and explicit assumptions in the proof environment.
